headlines.title: Supreme Court says New Hampshire student IDs can’t be used to vote in November
headlines.description: In a win for Republicans, the court said a federal judge should not have changed the rules so close to the Nov. 3 midterm elections.

headlines.title: DOJ Investigates allegations against Lewandowski
headlines.description: Tonight a person familiar with the matter tells NBC News the Department of Justice is investigating allegations against Corey Lewandowski, a former Trump campaign manager. NBC News’ Garrett Haake reports.

headlines.title: Hollywood remembers actor Tom Skerritt
headlines.description: The Emmy winner and lauded performer is being remembered as someone who believed stories can help people heal and create change. NBC News’ Anne Thompson reports

headlines.title: N.Y. AG James files opposition to effort to bar her from Cornell investigation
headlines.description: One of the men named in an explosive lawsuit alleging sexual assault at a Cornell fraternity house opposed Letitia James’ appointment as special prosecutor.

headlines.title: Trump hopes to flatter Putin into negotiating on Ukraine
headlines.description: A Trump diplomat called Putin “a humanitarian,” another in a recent flurry of overtures to the Russian leader. But it’s unclear whether blandishments will entice him to strike a deal.

headlines.title: Debbie Shields speaks out on her viral moment riffing with Conan O'Brien
headlines.description: Internet sensation Debbie Shields speaks with NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian about her recent viral video, where she stood out during an improvised conversation with Conan O'Brien on the popular internet talk show “Subway Takes.”

headlines.title: Hegseth staff damaged WWII-era Eisenhower globe trying to move it to his office
headlines.description: The globe was especially notable because it had green pen or marker notations where Gen. Dwight D. Eisenhower marked areas in Europe, three U.S. officials said.

headlines.title: DHS watchdog refers its Corey Lewandowski investigation to Justice Department for review
headlines.description: Lewandowski, the first manager on Trump’s 2016 presidential campaign, was a top aide to then-Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem before she was fired.

headlines.title: Atlanta Falcons post of retro team symbol draws Nazi imagery comparisons
headlines.description: The NFC club said it doesn’t have a new logo but otherwise declined to comment on the look.

headlines.title: Hackers appear to be struggling to exploit PHP flaws after global cybersecurity crisis
headlines.description: There were few, if any, reports of widespread damage by hackers exploiting PHP flaws, experts said, one day after officials warned of severe vulnerabilities.
